records.explanation: The warehouse has no credit score field or table: the notes describe invoices, deals, orders, payments, receivables and customer records, and none of them hold a credit rating, so I can't answer this from the data.

The warehouse notes describe no salesperson field: staging.stg_deals (the table for win counts) and marts.deal_to_cash have only deal, partner/customer, stage, revenue and date columns, and the listed other tables don't name one either, so deals cannot be attributed to a salesperson from the documented schema.

Gross margin needs cost of goods sold, and none of the documented tables (intermediate.int_invoices, marts.receivables_aging, marts.deal_to_cash, staging.stg_deals, or the listed other tables) has a cost or COGS column, so the warehouse cannot answer this without guessing; revenue alone for last quarter could be computed from intermediate.int_invoices if you want that instead.

The warehouse notes list no support ticket data: the marts, staging and intermediate tables cover CRM deals, sales orders, invoices, payments, partners and customers, and none of them record support tickets, so the warehouse cannot say how many tickets Acme Corporation opened.

The warehouse holds only posted invoices (intermediate.int_invoices) and past or current deal and order status, with no forecast, billing schedule, or planned invoice dates, so November 2026 billing cannot be computed without guessing; the closest available figure is the uninvoiced backlog in marts.deal_to_cash (status 'ordered, not invoiced'), which shows what is ordered but not when it will be billed.
